setting: Humanity arrives INSIDE a working megastructure the size of a solar system — a Dyson-class shell of nested rings, still lit, still warm, still drinking its star. The builders are simply GONE: no bodies, no graves, no war-scars, no fall. The structure is dormant in pieces; control-keys and access-sigils wake region after region. Each key both lights usable power/matter AND drops a fragment of the builders' PURPOSE — what this thing was built to DO and where they WENT. The ordered chain is retrospective: every activation enables the next, and the completed activation-sequence reveals a finished, abandoned purpose. Resource is vast but instrumental; the real prize is the answer to 'why', and whether finishing what they started is a gift or a trap.

civs.name: the-architects
civs.trait: the vanished makers — left a working machine and no remains; genuinely OTHER, genuinely gone, purpose unstated

civs.name: the-keepers
civs.trait: a successor caste of the builders who tended the structure after the makers left, then also vanished — they sequenced the shutdowns

civs.name: the-listeners
civs.trait: an earlier inheritor species that found the structure before humans, woke pieces, learned part of the purpose, and departed without explanation

climax_label: the structure completed and the makers vanished
